sentences.en: When he started dating, he experienced many epic failures.
sentences.zh: 1. 当他开始谈恋爱时，经历了很多惨痛的失败。

sentences.en: I don't even remember how the whole epic ended.
sentences.zh: 2. 我甚至不记得整个故事是怎么结束的了。

sentences.en: That book is a real epic; it's over one thousand pages long.
sentences.zh: 3. 那本书真是部巨著；它有一千多页。
